questions.question: In a row of children, Sanjay is ninth from the left and Sanjana is thirteenth from right. They exchange their positions and then Sanjay becomes seventeenth from the left. Find the new position of Sanjana from the right end of the row.
questions.questionHtml: In a row of children, Sanjay is ninth from the left and Sanjana is thirteenth from right. They exchange their positions and then Sanjay becomes seventeenth from the left. Find the new position of Sanjana from the right end of the row.
questions.solution:
Sanjay’s new position is 17th from the left and 13th from the right.

So, number of children in the row = (16+1+12) = 29

Now, Sanjana’s new position is Sanjay’s earlier position which is 9th from the left.

Number of children to the right of Sanjana = (29-9) = 20

Hence, Sanjana’s new position is 21st from the right.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word.)

Generous : Kind
questions.solution:
The correct answer is (c) Happy : Joyful

The words "Generous" and "Kind" are synonyms. Both words describe a similar quality—someone who is generous is also likely to be kind, as both traits involve being good or considerate towards others. "Happy" and "Joyful" are synonyms, just as "Generous" and "Kind" are.
